title: Level
description: A level of one's own over a base world (tools/xdl_level.py, src/game/Port_Level.c, docs-pending/mission-editor.md). Triggers are files of their own in triggers/ (Trigger.schema.json). Links: base://<archive>/world_0/<path> (the base world's records), level://<kind>/<name> (the level's own).

id.description: the track's id: saves and ids.lock key it

modId.description: the mod's id when packaged (default: from the level's)

name.description: its name in the world select

extends.description: the base level of the mode: its loading screen, steps, win and lose sequences

world.description: the world as the MCP names it (worlds_\sp_\chal1_\ch1_l2); its archive is what base:// links name

thumbnail.description: the world select's picture: a texture link (Mod.schema.json tracks)

baseTriggers.description: the base world's triggers that stay: all, none, or their numbers

triggers.description: the order of triggers/NAME.jsonc (default: by name)

additionalProperties.description: WorldVolume fields; center may be [x, y, z]; radiusSq defaults to radius squared (the game tests distance squared < radiusSq); enabled 1, shape sphere, type airbox by default
WorldTimer fields (time in ms, countUp, type: the id the HUD binds to); mode {mode, type}, default {23, 7}: shown, stopped

strings.description: texts (paragraphs) for print_debug_string and the like: level://strings/NAME is the game's string table

patches.description: base record path -> {field: number}: number fields of base records (field/member for embedded structs: pos/y)
